stories.title: EU calls for stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings
stories.description: Ursula von der Leyen has called for action ahead of an urgent EU interior ministers meeting to discuss the issue.

stories.title: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
stories.description: Three children were killed when the drone crashed at a popular resort on the Black Sea.

stories.title: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
stories.description: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.

stories.title: Ariana Grande has had enough of body comments, but 'scrutiny' will linger
stories.description: The star has taken a "step back" from the spotlight after appearances led to "endless, ongoing public scrutiny".

stories.title: France wildfires reveal hundreds of WW2 shells in village
stories.description: Explosions heard in Le Porge as the wildfires raged are believed to have have been the old munitions.

stories.title: I left my wife and twins behind - why this Nigerian man fled South Africa
stories.description: Nigerian Richard Itoro is one of tens of thousands who have abandoned their lives in South Africa.

stories.title: Watch: Wild police chase in Queensland, Australia ends in two arrests
stories.description: A police pursuit in Queensland has ended in two arrests, with authorities taken on a high-speed car chase across Ipswich and Brisbane.

stories.title: US states sue to block Trump tariffs impacting dozens of countries
stories.description: The duties were imposed over claims that 60 US trading partners have failed to tackle forced labour.

stories.title: Rhine falls to record low levels as drought strains Europe's rivers
stories.description: Low water levels in the Rhine, Danube and Po have curtailed the transport of goods and reduced electricity output.

stories.title: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first confirmed outside contact for 2.5 years
stories.description: Photos newly released by Myanmar's military government show Suu Kyi meeting with an ICRC official.
